room_rent.note: Room category and rent limit specified in schedule; proportional deduction applies if higher room availed

icu.note: ICU/CCU/HDU charges covered as specified in schedule

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan; co-pay applies if optional Co-pay benefit (3.3.6) is chosen, or if First Notification (3.3.4) or Preferred Provider Network (3.3.5) conditions are breached

sub_limits.note: Policy wording allows sub-limits to be specified in schedule; no fixed sub-limits stated in wording itself

deductible.note: Deductible only applies if Super Top-up option (3.3.7) is opted; amount specified in schedule

initial_waiting.note: Waivable via optional benefit 3.3.13 at inception only

ped_waiting.note: Wording references schedule for PED waiting period months; standard definition uses 36 months prior diagnosis window but actual waiting period not stated in wording

specific_disease_waiting.note: Standard specific waiting period is up to 24 months per definition; reducible via optional benefit 3.3.10

maternity.note: Maternity excluded under Excl18; ectopic pregnancy for in-patient only is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: NCB is an optional benefit (3.3.3); max NCB cannot exceed base SI; rate per year as per schedule

restoration.note: Restore Sum Insured (3.3.2) is optional; unlimited restorations for unrelated illnesses only; not available for same illness claimed in same year

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation covered; number of days specified in schedule

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation covered; number of days specified in schedule

day_care.note: Day care treatment covered as basic benefit 3.2.3

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered as basic benefit 3.2.7; minimum 3 consecutive days required; reimbursement only

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered as basic benefit 3.2.10; OPD AYUSH not covered

organ_donor.note: In-patient hospitalisation expenses of organ donor covered under 3.2.8; pre/post-hosp of donor excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered for emergency transport; limit as per schedule; domestic emergency evacuation also covered separately

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatment procedures covered under 3.2.11 including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo etc.

consumables.note: Non-payable expenses (Annexure 1) excluded by default; waivable via optional benefit 3.3.8 (Waiver of non-payable expenses)

global_cover.note: Worldwide in-patient hospitalisation available as optional basic benefit option 3.3.1

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly instalment

free_look.note: Applicable at inception only, not on renewals or porting

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; continuity of waiting period credits transferred

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, STDs (non-HIV), sleep disorders, hormone therapy, RF ablation, tobacco-related cancers, external congenital anomaly, substance abuse

optional_riders.display: Worldwide cover, Restore SI, NCB, Super Top-up, Co-pay, Consumables waiver, OPD cover, Daily hospital cash, Accidental death/disability, Inflation protect SI
